public_rationale: OpenAI made GPT-4 available within ChatGPT Plus on March 14, 2023 [e1]. AI Impacts' February 23, 2023 analysis documents ChatGPT search interest before that release, without measuring GPT-4 attention [e2]. These sources do not establish whether GPT-4 attracted substantially more public attention than the earlier ChatGPT, including whether more people discussed it [e1, e2]. The predicted increase in attention remains unresolved on this evidence [e1, e2].
limitations: The packet provides no comparable attention measurements for both launches.
GPT-4 discussion could appear under the ChatGPT name because GPT-4 was available within that product.
Search volume alone does not count the people discussing a subject.
The claim specifies no attention measure, comparison window or numerical threshold.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: GPT-4 will eclipse ChatGPT and attract even more attention.

statement.excerpt: When it comes out, it will totally eclipse ChatGPT; it’s safe bet that even more people will be talking about it..
statement.document_title: What to Expect When You’re Expecting … GPT-4

from_speaker: even more people will be talking about it
our_interpretation: Read together, these phrases predict that GPT-4's release will attract substantially more public attention than ChatGPT had attracted.
The comparison is with the ChatGPT available when Marcus wrote the post, rather than all later versions of that product.
Search interest, news coverage and public discussion can measure attention, but none alone measures the number of people talking.
Marcus specifies neither a measurement window nor a numerical threshold. The surrounding reference to a rumored spring release is not a firm deadline.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable measurements show that attention surrounding GPT-4's release substantially exceeded attention surrounding ChatGPT's introduction, with a consistent result across reasonable launch windows and measures.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable measurements show that GPT-4's release attracted no more attention than ChatGPT's introduction, with a consistent result across reasonable launch windows and measures.

evidence.excerpt: We’re excited to bring GPT-4, our latest model, to our ChatGPT Plus subscribers.
evidence.explanation: GPT-4's release satisfies the forecast's antecedent. Its distribution within ChatGPT also makes comparisons based only on the two names difficult to interpret.
This Google Trends analysis documents substantial attention to ChatGPT before GPT-4's release. It does not measure GPT-4 or establish which launch attracted more attention.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A retrospective comparison of attention surrounding both launches using comparable populations, platforms, geographic coverage and launch-relative windows. It should account for GPT-4 discussion under the ChatGPT name and establish a consistent direction across reasonable windows and multiple attention measures.
